description:
Get Indeed Job Details

Fetches a single Indeed job posting by its viewjob URL. Returns job title, company, location, salary/compensation, employment type, full description, and benefits. Use for ATS/CRM enrichment, compensation benchmarking, resume-to-JD matching with LLMs, and structured archival of postings discovered via the Indeed Listing endpoint.

url.description: The URL of the job vacancy to retrieve details for.
